WITH order_fills AS (
  SELECT oe.ordersmark,
         o.timespan,
         AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_fill
  FROM orderexecutions AS oe
  JOIN orders AS o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY oe.ordersmark, o.timespan
),
time_in_force_means AS (
  SELECT timespan, AVG(avg_fill) AS mean_avg_fill
  FROM order_fills
  GROUP BY timespan
),
ranked_orders AS (
  SELECT f.ordersmark,
         f.timespan,
         f.avg_fill,
         f.avg_fill - m.mean_avg_fill AS excess_fill,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY f.timespan
           ORDER BY f.avg_fill DESC NULLS LAST
         ) AS fill_rank
  FROM order_fills AS f
  JOIN time_in_force_means AS m ON f.timespan IS m.timespan
  WHERE f.avg_fill > m.mean_avg_fill
)
SELECT ordersmark, timespan, avg_fill, excess_fill, fill_rank
FROM ranked_orders
WHERE fill_rank <= 3;
